title: Operating-mode state (loop vs harness) + auto-flip + manual toggle
description: BETA-TEST GOAL (goal-mode-switch), part 1 of 2. Give the framework an explicit operating MODE so it can switch between 'harness' (the normal manual, human-gated, one-step-at-a-time orchestrator workflow) and 'loop' (the autonomous drive loop). The mode lives in session state, auto-flips when the drive loop starts/stops, can be toggled manually, and is surfaced through the bounded session projection so the console can show it (TASK-064 renders it). Built on the `beta` branch as the first dogfood-drive goal for /agentic-framework-beta:loop. Backward-compatible: absent mode = 'harness'.
acceptance_criteria: Session state carries a `mode` field with values 'harness' (default) | 'loop'; absence is treated as 'harness' (backward-compatible, existing bundles unaffected).

A small module/API (e.g. src/operating-mode.js) exports getMode({repoRoot}) and setMode({repoRoot, mode}) with enum validation (reject anything other than harness|loop) and atomic writes; setMode is idempotent.

Auto-flip: the drive loop sets mode='loop' when it starts driving (after acquiring the TASK-061 lock) and back to 'harness' when it exits/pauses/releases. Wire this into commands/loop.md's control flow AND expose the helper the loop calls; document it in the orchestrator-routing 'Autonomous loop' subsection.
Manual toggle: a way to set the mode explicitly outside the loop (a function + a /agentic-framework-beta:mode command, or a documented setMode call) so a human can flip it without running the loop.
src/session-projection.js includes `mode` in its bounded projection so GET /api/session exposes the current mode (never dumps the full bundle).

tdd: failing tests first encoding default='harness', setMode enum validation (valid flips + rejected garbage), absent-bundle backward-compat, and projection-includes-mode. Then implement. New disk/e2e specs under tests/e2e/; pure-logic at top level.

If any bundled source changes (task-board/session-projection are bundled into dist/task-board.cjs), rebuild dist via npm run build:plugin and commit; npm run test:all green (state-shape change → release-tier gate).
